title: A batch of oracle reports charges the protocol fee once per asset
rootCause: FeeManager.updateState moves the fee timestamp only for the base asset, and ShareModule.handleReport charges the protocol fee on every report, so each report ahead of the base asset in a batch charges the whole elapsed period again.

poc.observable: test_a_batch_of_reports_charges_the_year_once fails with "one year of the fee, charged once: 331000000000000000000 != 100000000000000000000"
